scope: Synthetic isolated Mongo subsystem using actual settleTransition and recoverProjections; no production data or world simulation.

performance.scope: One ordinary two-leg transition with one update projection, measured before replay calls. All Mongo commands and complete command/reply BSON included.

limitations: Synthetic actors and documents; no retained-world or production observation.
No economy formulas, loan terms, authority or activation flags changed.
Historical unfinished projections without surviving proof remain partial for explicit reconciliation.
The measured boundary does not establish a whole-phase budget or whole-world accounting closure.
Generic money-leg durability is qualified separately.

focusedChecks.scope: Prior projection, existing settlement journal and interbank checks, before the selector compatibility follow-up.

compatibility.scope: Crisis treasury legs and projections retain stable budget identities. Nonliteral projection selectors are bound before journal admission; an unavailable target is durably rejected before cash movement.
